This game has two self-test switches. The primary one is conveniently located inside the upper coin door (inside the left edge of the opening). The secondary sell test switch is located on the JSA Audio HT PCB, in the drawer behind the control panel

To enter the self-test, turn on the self-test switch inside the upper coin door, Doing so displays the Select Test menu (entitled “Self Test”): see Figure 2-1. Exit the self-test by turning off the self-test switch at any time.

When you turn on the power, the game automatically runs through the random-ac memory (RAM) and read-only memory (ROM) test. This test is not part of the self-test procedure.
